_comment: Read-side registry for outlook-ingest-agent (.claude/agents/outlook-ingest-agent.md). Mailbox, folders, window, and classification hints live here so a new supplier domain or a renamed folder is a one-line data edit, never a change to the agent file. Verified live against the Outlook/M365 MCP connector 2026-08-02.
_maintenance: Folder names are EXACT MATCH (case-insensitive) against Outlook. The connector recognizes the standard set (Inbox, Sent Items, Drafts, Deleted Items, Archive, Junk Email, Outbox) directly; any other name is resolved by enumerating the mailbox, so a renamed custom folder silently returns nothing. Sender lists below are OVERRIDES, not the whole classifier — the agent classifies semantically and consults these only to force a bucket.

mailbox._comment: App-only Graph access reads all of these directly — no delegation needed, which is why info@ works here after the session connector could not touch it (FORBIDDEN/ErrorItemNotFound, 2026-08-02). OUTLOOK_MAILBOXES in .env overrides this list; keep the two in sync.
mailbox.shared_mailboxes_note: A mailbox here MUST also be a member of titan-ingest-mailboxes@titanfloors.ca, the group the Exchange Application Access Policy is scoped to — otherwise Graph returns 403 for it while the other mailboxes still succeed (status: partial).
mailbox.staff_mailboxes_note: Personal work mailboxes, not a shared company inbox. Items from these ALWAYS get sensitivity 'private' — a staff member's mail must never be routed to a team-visible Notion board on the strength of a keyword match.

scan.max_catchup_note: If the most recent prior outlook.json is older than window_hours, widen the window to cover the gap, capped at this many days. Outlook ingest went dark 2026-07-26..07-31 with no connector; a catch-up run must not silently skip those days.

classification._comment: Match on the sender's full address or any domain suffix listed. A sender matching more than one list resolves in this order: admin > supplier > customer > noise (money and deadlines outrank marketing).
classification.supplier_senders_note: Seed as real supplier domains surface (Olympia Tile, CIF Distributors, flooring vendors). Empty means the agent falls back to semantic classification — it does not mean 'no suppliers'.
noise_subject_patterns: a new device logged into your account
classification.escalate_from_noise_note: A sender on noise_senders still becomes an `admin` item if the message reports a FAILED payment, an account suspension, or a password/MFA change Albert did not initiate. Routine login and marketing notices stay noise.

notion_task_eligible_mailboxes_note: HARD RULE, Albert 2026-08-02: a Notion task is never created from an Outlook item that arrived anywhere else. Not because staff mail doesn't matter, but because it has no correct destination yet — the team board is wrong (personal mail) and Albert's private database is wrong (it would be someone else's task, filed in his inbox). info@ is the company inbox, so it has a valid destination today. Enforced in contracts/notion-task-schema.md and .claude/commands/notion-sync.md, which read the mailbox from raw_ref and FAIL CLOSED when it is absent. Not the same lever as `sensitivity`, which only forces an approval prompt — and approvals get given by mistake.
notion_task_eligible_mailboxes_direction: Albert 2026-08-03: each staff member is to get their own private Notion database, with their mailbox's findings routing there. Sequence matters — add the per-person destination to notion-destinations.json FIRST (write_policy: approval_required, owned by that person), then widen this list by one entry. Widening this list before the destination exists produces exactly the misfiling the rule prevents.
